deadline.value: Applications for funding consideration are due January 30; applications received by April 15 get full consideration for admission (no year on the page).
deadline.quote: The application deadline for funding consideration is January 30.

funding.value: Most full-time PhD students have teaching assistantships, or are research fellows.
funding.quote: Most of our full-time graduate students pursuing the PhD have teaching assistantships, or in some cases are supported as research fellows.

entry_route.value: Applicants without a master's should apply to the PhD programme directly.

gre_subject.value: No Mathematics GRE Subject test is mentioned on the department pages.
